summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError) and tests in test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py. The new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (41 tests). Nothing is committed. mypy, black, and isort are not installed in the generator venv and could not be installed, so type-checking and formatting are unverified; line lengths were checked by hand and are within 88 columns. Key choices: the non-node guard binds the argument to an object-typed local so mypy does not flag the check as unreachable; modifier paths use three explicit branches with literal modifier text; non-node and Literal cases are separate test functions.
